name: Farstrider Lodge
summary: In southeastern Loch Modan, Farstrider Lodge welcomes hunters and travelers bound for the wilds. Its high elven style sets it apart, though dwarves and humans live there too.

sections.title: An Elven Haven in the Mountains
sections.body: Farstrider Lodge looks unlike the stone buildings of Khaz Modan. Its design recalls high elven craft, though Vyrin Swiftwind is the only known high elf still living there. Dwarves and humans make their homes beside him. No one knows who founded the lodge or when it was built.

sections.title: A Waystation for the Wilds
sections.body: In the southeastern hills of Loch Modan, Farstrider Lodge offers hunters and travelers a place to stop before entering the wilds. Hunter and pet trainers work there, alongside merchants. Others come seeking help with local wildlife.

faq.q: Why is there an elven lodge in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: Farstrider Lodge bears a design that suggests high elven origins, and Vyrin Swiftwind is its only known high elven resident. No one knows who founded it, when it was built, or what its first purpose was.

faq.q: Are there still high elves living here?
faq.answer: Vyrin Swiftwind is the only high elf known to live at Farstrider Lodge. Dwarves and humans live there too, including mountaineers and huntsmen who maintain the lodge and trade with travelers.

faq.q: What services are available at Farstrider Lodge?
faq.answer: Farstrider Lodge has hunter and pet trainers, merchants, and requests for help with Loch Modan's wilderness.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can find marksmanship and beast training at Farstrider Lodge, amid the game in Loch Modan's surrounding hills.
As a dwarf, you share Farstrider Lodge with human residents and the high elf Vyrin Swiftwind.
